subject: model fit statistics for user-specified model with SNP effects

messages.author: 1ade312b2b5688ec
messages.subject: model fit statistics for user-specified model with SNP effects
parts:
Hi All,

I notice that we can get a set of fit statistics such as AIC, CFI and SRMR in models without SNP effects. But for models with SNP effects, I can only get Chisq and AIC. Is it possible for us to get more fit statistics (CFI, TLI, SRMR) as outputs for user-specified models with SNP effects through the GenomicSEM package?

Thanks for your help.

Best,
Zihang

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: model fit statistics for user-specified model with SNP effects
parts:
Hi Zihang, 

Apologies for the delayed response! Since CFI and SRMR require some extra calculations in the context of the GWAS, adding in those fit statistics would significantly slow down run time. As we look towards continuing to optimize in performance we will also try and add in more features on the GWAS end, but for now those specific fit statistics are not available for userGWAS functions. 

Best, 
  Andrew
